end_state: The operator surfaces become useful rather than merely present. In ap-web/src: (1) System, Fleet, Models and Training are folded into the single Advanced tab with three sub-tabs — connections, helpers and health — written in the plain vocabulary established in phase 1; (2) Training gains a drill-down from a category to the individual routines failing within it, and an action on each, so a number on that page can be acted upon; (3) Fleet gains a legend explaining every edge and node style, a fit-to-view control, and a default view that answers 'who is working on my request right now'; (4) any list that can exceed fifty rows gains a search field, including the routines list; (5) every panel that polls displays the time its data is from, and stale data is visually distinct from live data. Changes are confined to ap-web/src. The TypeScript build and the vitest suite both pass.
inspection_criteria: Every statistic shown can be acted upon or drilled into.
No list over fifty rows lacks a search field.
Stale data is visually distinguishable from live data.
Fleet has a legend for every visual encoding it uses.
The brand identity (wolf, wordmark, theme, slogan) remains unchanged.
blocked_conditions: A drill-down requires an endpoint that does not exist.
The vitest suite cannot pass without removing a test asserting correct behaviour.
